claim: tmux has been available for fifteen years
source_quote: The solution has been sitting in Linux servers for fifteen years, largely ignored.

claim: tmux enables terminal sessions that survive disconnection
source_quote: At its core, tmux solves one fundamental problem: terminal sessions that survive disconnection.

claim: Sessions are top-level containers that can be named for later reference
source_quote: Sessions are the top-level containers, named so you can reference them later.

claim: Windows function like browser tabs, running multiple instances within a single session
source_quote: Windows are like browser tabs, multiple running inside a single session.

claim: Panes are split screens within windows, and agents can read and interact with other panes in the same session
source_quote: Panes are split screens within those windows, and here's the clever part: agents can read and interact with other panes in the same session.

claim: tmux terminology takes five minutes to learn
source_quote: The terminology takes five minutes to learn.

claim: Command 'tmux new' creates a new session
source_quote: Create a session with "tee mux new" and a name.

claim: Control+B then D detaches from a session while keeping it alive
source_quote: Detach with control B then D, which drops you back to your normal terminal while the session stays alive.

claim: Command 'tmux attach' reattaches to a named session
source_quote: Reattach with "tee mux attach" targeting the session name.

claim: Command 'tmux ls' lists all running sessions
source_quote: List everything running with "tee mux L S".

claim: Command 'tmux kill-server' terminates all tmux sessions
source_quote: If things go sideways, "tee mux kill dash server" wipes everything clean.

claim: HostingHer is named as a cheap VPS provider
source_quote: Cheap VPS providers like HostingHer offer KVM two plans that cost less than a monthly streaming subscription.

claim: tmux can be installed using apt package manager
source_quote: Install tmux with apt, enable mouse support for easier navigation, then SSH in from anywhere.

claim: Slash goal commands can execute for twenty-four hours or more
source_quote: Slash goal commands that execute for twenty-four hours or more.

claim: tmux enables multiple specialized agents working in parallel in separate panes
source_quote: A single developer can orchestrate multiple specialized agents working in parallel, each in its own pane, each contributing to a larger workflow.

claim: tmux on a VPS is described as practical but unglamorous infrastructure
source_quote: tmux on a VPS isn't glamorous, but it's the kind of infrastructure that quietly makes everything else possible.
